jobs.description:
Get an awesome salary of €16,78 and enjoy working dayshifts only! All while working with the best smelling flowers. Read on and watch your new job as an orderpicker blossom, literally. 🌸 Apply today at Royal FloraHolland in Honselersdijk! 🥳

What we offer
- € 16,60 bruto per hour
- Opportunity for a permanent contract!
- Travel allowance or public transport subscription
- Participation in staff association & fun events!
- Get €0,18 extra allowance. You'll get €16,78 p/h💸
- Enjoy free flowers up to 5 times a year! 💐

Who you are
To make sure everything runs smoothly, it's important that as an orderpicker, you'll meet the following requirements:

- You are available at least 3 days a week, especially on Mondays.
- You can start working at 05:45h and the ending time is between 09:30h and 12:00h.
- You have your own place to stay in The Netherlands.
- You are available at least till October.
- You speak Dutch or English.
- You can work in Honselersdijk.
- You meet the 1.65m height requirement.

What will you do
Every day, so many flowers leave Royal FloraHolland to be delivered to shops and florists across the country. 🌼 And they have to arrive fresh and flawless. Before the stores even open! That’s where you, as an orderpicker, come in.

Early in the morning, you’ll be working with carts full of beautiful flowers. You check if everything is correct: Are the flowers fresh and in good condition? Does the cart match the order?
Once everything is perfect, you roll the cart to the right spot. Then, a small electric vehicle (kind of like a mini lawn mower!) picks it up and brings it straight to the truck. Thanks to your work, the flowers arrive on time and in top shape at their destination! 🙌

Where will you work
You’ll be working at the world’s largest flower auction site! Yes, really! That’s how massive the warehouse in Honselersdijk (near Naaldwijk) is. As an orderpicker, you will find  your way around in no time though. Within weeks  you’ll be driving like a pro

jobs.occupation: Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden
jobs.description:
Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice between weekly and four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Development opportunities within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Leiden, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. At the start of your shift, you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel of the delivery van and head towards your first customer. At each stop, you select the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You greet the customer, hand over the groceries and provide friendly service. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next address. This is not a job where you spend your entire shift sitting behind the wheel. Throughout the day, you regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' homes and lift grocery crates. Driving, physical activity and customer contact are all part of the position. You complete your route independently, which means you are responsible for driving safely and handling the orders carefully. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I apply without delivery experience? Yes. Previous experience as a delivery driver, courier or professional driver is not required. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the delivery process and become familiar with the job before completing routes

independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I need to work every Saturday? No. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. In addition to driving, you will regularly carry grocery crates from the van to customers' doors. You will also be getting in and out of the vehicle throughout your route, so you need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Would you like to combine driving with an active and varied job in Leiden? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

To round things off, you'll get a glimpse into our Planning Department, where we're busy around the summer planning and organising the planting of our strawberry plants.

We're looking for:
